title: Sara Duterte glad ICC judges got to see dad’s condition

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday said she was happy that the International Criminal Court (ICC) judges saw the physical state of her father Rodrigo Duterte during a recent procedural hearing on the charges of crimes against humanity against him. The former president personally appeared for the very first time during the ICC Trial Chamber III’s third status conference last Wednesday. “I am glad that a status conference was held and the judges finally saw the state of PRD.
